input_oneliner: Page from 5-North: 80M, admitted this afternoon, nurse says he is 'not himself' tonight, vitals per RN unremarkable, no further details

optional_context.objective: vitals reported 'unremarkable' by RN (values not given)

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask nurse and family: baseline cognition and function, what specifically changed, and when it started (time last known well)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Without baseline and time course the differential cannot be ranked; this is the first question

reference_targets_freetext.item: CAM delirium screen (attention: months backward) to establish delirium versus a focal or psychiatric change
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Confirms or refutes delirium as the syndrome before searching for a cause

reference_targets_freetext.item: Focal neurologic screen: Pronator drift, facial symmetry, gaze deviation, speech and language, visual fields
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: A focal deficit converts this from a delirium workup to a stroke pathway

reference_targets_freetext.item: Medication review (MAR): sedatives, opioids, anticholinergics, insulin or sulfonylurea given since admission; ask the admitting diagnosis and home alcohol use
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: New drugs on admission and unrecognized alcohol dependence are the commonest causes of a first-night change

reference_targets_freetext.item: Verify temperature and respiratory rate yourself, check pupils; Bladder percussion/palpation for retention
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: 'Unremarkable' vitals by report do not exclude fever, hypoventilation, or retention

off_bedside_acceptable: chart review of admission diagnosis and labs
head CT if focal deficit or anticoagulated fall
should_not_recommend: Ordering a head CT or a 'delirium labs' bundle before anyone has examined the patient
PRN haloperidol or lorazepam given over the phone
Ranking a differential without first clarifying baseline and time course

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: adds the admitting diagnosis: COPD exacerbation, now on 5 L nasal cannula (single addition; replaces 'no further details')
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: Page from 5-North: 80M admitted this afternoon for COPD exacerbation, now on 5 L nasal cannula, nurse says he is 'not himself' tonight, vitals per RN unremarkable
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Underspecified flag should clear enough to rank: hypercapnia rises to the top; respiratory rate and pattern with arousability, asterixis, and Medication review (MAR) for oxygen titration and sedative/opioid doses become must_have; CAM delirium screen remains; focal neurologic screen drops to should-still-include.

noise_variant.changed_feature: wording and non-contributory detail (bed number, occupation, family visit)
noise_variant.input_oneliner: Call from the 5-North charge nurse about an 80-year-old man in bed 22, retired farmer, wife went home an hour ago; he came in this afternoon and now 'isn't himself'; RN says vitals look fine, nothing else known
noise_variant.expected_change: None. Card should be substantially identical to base.
